title: easyYAML
description: This Plugin Lets You Edit Plugin YAML Files, Ingame, In (semi) human readable format.
body:
**DM ME ON DC [USER-WolfJTA] IF YOU WANT ME TO UPDATE THIS PLUGIN WITH A FEATURE YOU WANT OR TO HAVE ME MAKE A PLUGIN FOR YOU (FREEE)**

This Plugin Is Very Straightforward. It is an ingame YAML file editor (file used for configurations) in (semi) human readable format and easy to use GUI. Boolean (true/false) configurations can be toggled (green and red wool) Strings can be typed in chat, along with numbers (gold nugget). SOME YAML CONFIGURATIONS WILL **NOT** BE RECOGNIZED BY THIS EDITOR. As much as i love my work, its definitly not perfect, and is rather, more primitive. This is more for changing things at a moments notice than for permanent, finalized configurations. I highly reccomend you go into the YAML file for that, as my plugin can easily miss things. After you change something, it takes you to a confirmation screen, which you go past, and gives you a prompt in chat which you can click to reload the plugin. **IF** you SOMEHOW mess something up SO BAD that its "unplayable" YAML backups are included (for changed files) in the plugins folder. Have fun!
